Alex H: GatewayEdge (SI + hardware partner) says marketplace demo leads in EU are being routed to Redwood SDRs. They insist that when they provide on-prem hardware for a POC they should own initial follow-up. Thoughts?

Nina P: Short answer: ownership depends on lead origin + contribution. If the partner paid for introduction/ran discovery (timestamped), they get a claim. If marketplace flow created the lead, default to Redwood SDRs for 48h.

Carlos G: For hardware partners we also need to capture "field-resource" commitments (does SI provide onsite engineer). If GatewayEdge supplies rack-and-stack for a POC, thats a material contribution and should affect crediting.

Jordan (SI Ops): Proposal: extend mapping table schema to include partner_contribution (none/remote_onboard/onsite_hw), claim_window_hours, arr_threshold, default_owner. Routing rule: marketplace_lead + partner_contribution in (onsite_hw, remote_onboard) -> partner gets 24h soft-claim if proof provided; otherwise 48h to Redwood.

Kevin BD: Also require partners to specify a named technical lead on claims (name + email + company). That reduces disputes and speeds handoffs.

Maya Legal: Any proof artifacts (screenshot, signed webhook, signed SOW excerpt) must be retained 12 months. If GatewayEdge's MSA grants exclusive intro rights, mark contract_entitlement=true in the table. I'll check their MSA.

Alex H: For POC credits: if partner supplies hardware or onsite engineer, give them lead credit but Redwood retains contract ownership unless MSA says otherwise. Suggest a simple credit system: partner_credit = bool + note in CRM.

Nina P: We should add a short "claims API" contract for partners who want programmatic claims: payload = {"lead_id","partner_id","timestamp","proof_url","signature"}. Verify signature via partner key. Manual claims require screenshot + time-of-click + cc of Redwood rep.

Carlos G: Operational detail: include tech-contact mapping in Confluence (fields: lead_id, account_tech_contact, partner_tech, hardware_on_site boolean). When partner claims, we auto-add partner_tech to the CRM contact list.

Jordan (SI Ops): Routing pseudo-code: 
- if lead.origin == "marketplace" and partner_contribution in ["onsite_hw","remote_onboard"] then claim_window = 24h else claim_window = 48h;
- if partner submits signed webhook within window then owner = partner else owner = Redwood_SDR;
- if estimated_ARR >= arr_threshold_followup -> owner = Redwood_SDR regardless;
- if contested -> escalate to #partnerships-triage for ops review;
- write audit: claim_proof_url + partner_tech_contact + field_resource_note.

Kevin BD: Add a marketing/announce rule: any joint announcement involving partner-supplied hardware requires a product security review and 10 business days prep. Mark exceptions for urgent enterprise wins.

Maya Legal: Action: Ill review GatewayEdge MSA for any exclusive clauses and draft a short addendum template for partners who want claim rights.

Alex H: Action items: Nina - add partner_contribution and claim_window to Confluence schema by Wed; Jordan - update SI Ops playbook + triage workflow; Carlos - implement CRM contact auto-add for partner_tech; Kevin - notify PM/Product re: announce gating for HW. Pilot this for 30 days with GatewayEdge.

announce-bot: Reminder  Partnerships sync tomorrow 9:30am PT -> https://cal.redwood/partnerships

Nina P: One more: make schema exportable (CSV/JSON) so Marketplace can enforce the windows automatically.

Alex H: Great. Lets keep the pilot narrow and instrument contested rates.
